Peer Assessment Rubric

  • Commentary Categorization & Erudition (4 pts): The commentary notes exhibit genuine scholarly depth, clearly distinguishing between linguistic glosses, historical context, and verified literary allusions.
  • Stand-Off TEI & LOD Pointers (3 pts): The stand-off markup is valid, accurately anchored to text coordinates, and includes functional Linked Open Data URI attributes.
  • Text Reuse & Architecture Reflection (3 pts): The 300–500 word analysis insightfully critiques the limitations of purely statistical text-reuse algorithms and defends the selected TEI annotation model.
